body:
Using import {forEach} from 'lodash'; seems not supported in lodash 3:
the function is imported but also the whole lodash code is exposed and
erase the `window._`.

Not good!

This is a hotfix

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @Jerskouille, @pixelastic and @bobylito to be potential reviewers

title: fix(lodash): stop leaking lodash in the global scope
